page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8a.32xlarge is an enterprise-grade, memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9T24 processors utilizing the x86_64 architecture with a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. Configured with 128 dedicated vCPUs and 1024 GB of system RAM, it maintains an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio that delivers substantial capacity for memory-bound computational tasks.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps, accommodating high-throughput data transfers across infrastructure environments. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external cloud storage volumes for all operating system and persistent data needs. Additionally, it features zero GPUs and does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which necessitates separate planning for routing and address allocation.

From a cost-efficiency and sizing perspective, the hardware architecture provides high memory density per compute core, making it an efficient deployment target where scaling memory capacity is prioritized over discrete accelerators. The ecs.r8a.32xlarge is well suited for large in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, large-scale data analytics, and memory-intensive ETL pipelines.
